decisions.reason: The accelerator program is cheap to keep, still features on the home page and adds ecosystem and deal-flow option value, though it sits outside the firm's core machinery business and is easy to cut if resources tighten.
The bio-based CO2-negative bitumen binder is a flagship with highly uncertain but potentially large value, still has its own page, and costs little to keep open while market uncertainty resolves.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is a flagship partnership with ERMAFA, close to the core offer, and was reinforced on the home page in 2024, so its prospects justify continued commitment.
